correlation.why: modelRequestId is minted in agent-runtime.ts:2915 (streamPreparedRequest), AFTER prepareTurnForModelRequest has returned and therefore AFTER the compaction decision.
correlation.provider_dispatch_join_reason: The decision's (sessionId, iteration) is available at the provider-dispatch seam, but a join that asserts the decision and the dispatch describe the SAME REQUEST attempt would require an authoritative mapping that the current seam does not publish. The ACT therefore does NOT manufacture a join from timestamps. The three objects are kept separate: the decision request (never submitted), the submitted request (post-compaction), and the previous provider usage.
objects_never_conflated: Decision request — the candidate CONSIDERED for compaction (requestInputTokens at the decision seam). Never submitted.
Submitted request — the final payload after compaction and subsequent transforms (provider_ready / provider_submitted).
Previous provider usage — tokens from an EARLIER request (actualPreviousInputTokens).
